title: Knobby Crispy Australian Mushroom Skillet
description: A lazy Sunday Australian dish featuring umami flavors and crispy mushrooms, made with olive oil and shio-cure, and is dairy-free friendly. This skillet is perfect for a relaxing weekend meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the shio-cure, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Continue cooking the mushrooms for an additional 5 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the mushrooms and stir to combine.
Serve the mushrooms hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
Let the skillet cool before washing.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
